qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant Swiss pharmacy network and wholesale distribution infrastructure (Galexis/Alloga), but sub-hurdle 10% ROIC and triennial statutory FOPH/BAG drug price cuts prevent raising prices above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Dominant Swiss pharmacy network and healthcare distributor with resilient volumes, but 5-year median ROIC of 10.0% falls strictly below the 12% hurdle. Furthermore, triennial statutory drug price cuts and regulated dispensing margins mandated by the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health (FOPH/BAG) permanently cap pricing power below inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Galenica generates consistent but structurally sub-hurdle returns on capital across 2021-2025: reported ROIC has ranged tightly between 9.2% and 10.1% (5-year median 10.0%, failing the >=12% test). Core prescription medicine revenue is subject to statutory price reviews by the Swiss FOPH (BAG) that enforce structural price cuts across reimbursable medicines, limiting top-line pricing power despite retail service expansion and generic substitution buffers.
